payload.text: The tap's CI runs brew style and brew audit --strict again: 434d105 is on the tap's main (hv, decision 9), and run 43922068740 is green on macos-15 (attempt 2, after attempt 1 got no runner) and ubuntu-22.04 (https://github.com/matthewsinclair/homebrew-ccusage/actions/runs/43922068740). Released when vc lands b3ca1c1 from branch dc/tap-ci-docs on main. Then dc removes the worktree ~/Devel/scratch/ccusage-dc/wt-tap-ci-docs and the branch by the usual checks, and the scratch clone ~/Devel/scratch/ccusage-dc/homebrew-ccusage and ~/Devel/scratch/ccusage-dc/tap-style-audit.patch with them.
